The comparison should be made using the reports that will be published according to the Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2835 of 4 November 2024 and the updated Transparency Database schema.

The focus of the support contract should be on developing meaningful, per-platform quantitative indicators reports published in the covered timeframe., The support contract should also propose operational recommendations for compliance monitoring, including recommendations for future schema updates to the DSA Transparency Database or improvements to the Transparency Reports’' templates.
